meta.title: Kashshof — find support that may fit your situation
meta.description: Tell Kashshof what is happening. It helps women and families in Uzbekistan find financial, family, disability, legal and other support — and explains why each program may fit.

shell.quickExitHint: Leaves this site immediately and clears this conversation. You can also press Esc twice.

footer.label: More
footer.tagline: Kashshof — support for women and families in Uzbekistan
footer.prototype: A university capstone prototype. Program information comes from public sources and hasn’t been reviewed by a person yet.
footer.notOfficial: Kashshof is not a government service and doesn’t make eligibility decisions.

home.title: You don’t have to figure out where to start alone.
home.lead: Tell Kashshof what is happening, in Uzbek, Russian or English. It checks the support programs it knows about and shows which ones may be worth looking into — and why.
home.trustLabel: What you can expect from Kashshof

noAccount.title: No account required
noAccount.body: No name, phone number or passport needed to search.

explains.body: What fits, what still needs checking, and what may rule you out.

sources.body: Each program links to the public page its information came from.

singleParent.title: A single parent looking for financial support
singleParent.story: I’m raising two children alone in Tashkent and I lost my job last month. I need financial support for my family.

childDisability.title: A family caring for a child with a disability
childDisability.story: We live in Samarkand. Our daughter is 8 and has a disability. We need support for her treatment and care.

legal.title: Someone looking for legal help
legal.story: I live in Fergana and I’m 34. I need free legal advice about child support after my divorce.

privacy.title: Kashshof does not create a personal profile from your story.
privacy.memory: What you tell us stays in this page’s memory. Refreshing, closing the tab or pressing Quick exit clears it.
privacy.neverStored: It is never put in the web address, saved on our server, or sent to analytics.
privacy.organizations: No organization sees anything unless you contact them yourself.

modes.neitherDecides: Either way, the same fixed rules decide which programs may fit. You can switch later.

private.name: Private guided
private.description: Your answers stay in this browser session. Kashshof will guide you using predefined questions.
private.short: Your answers stay in this browser session; no AI service sees them.

ai.name: AI-assisted
ai.description: Your messages are processed by Google Gemini to help understand your situation. Gemini does not decide which support programs you qualify for.
ai.short: Your messages are processed by Google Gemini to understand them. Gemini doesn’t decide which programs may fit.

ask.title: Find support
ask.startLead: Describe it in your own words, or answer a few short questions. Share only what you’re comfortable with — you can skip anything.
ask.storyPlaceholder: For example: I’m raising two children alone in Andijan and need help with school costs…
ask.storyHint: No names, phone numbers or ID numbers needed.
ask.dangerLead: If you are in danger right now:
ask.memoryNote: Refreshing or closing this page clears the conversation.
ask.restartBody: This clears the conversation and your answers from this page.
ask.noDocuments: The source doesn’t list standard documents. Check “How to apply” and confirm with the organization.
ask.errorBody: Your answers are still here, and nothing about your situation has changed. Please try again.
ask.aiFallbackBody: AI assistance isn’t responding right now, so this reply came from Kashshof’s predefined questions. Your search works the same way.

safety.continuing: Of course. We can continue at your pace — and the Quick exit button is always at the top.

safety.title: You deserve to be safe.
safety.lead: If you feel unsafe at home or anywhere else, help is available. You don’t need to explain or prove anything to ask for it.
safety.dangerBody: Call 112. It is free and works from any phone, in every region.
safety.n1146: Trust line for women facing pressure or violence
safety.tipQuickExit: Press “Quick exit” at the top, or Esc twice, to leave this site at once. It clears your conversation with Kashshof and replaces this page, so Back won’t return here.
safety.tipErased: Your conversation is kept only in this page’s memory. Refreshing or closing the tab also clears it.
safety.tipHistory: Kashshof can’t delete your browser history. If someone checks your device, consider a private or incognito window, and clear your history afterwards.
safety.tipPhone: Calls to the numbers above may appear in your phone’s call log.
safety.servicesLead: Collected from public sources. You don’t need documents to contact them.

safetyPanel.title: Your safety comes first
safetyPanel.body: If you are in danger right now, call 112 — it’s free from any phone. You don’t have to explain anything else here.
safetyPanel.allHelp: See all urgent numbers and confidential services
safetyPanel.quickExit: Quick exit, at the top of the page (or Esc twice), leaves this site immediately and clears this conversation.

how.title: How Kashshof works
how.lead: Kashshof helps you find support programs that may fit your situation. A language model may help with the conversation — but it never decides what exists or who qualifies.
how.flowTitle: From your story to explained results

story.title: Your story
story.body: In your own words, or through tappable answers.

assistant.title: Conversation assistant
assistant.body: Gemini (if you choose AI-assisted) or predefined questions turn your words into a few facts.

facts.title: Structured facts
facts.body: Kind of support, region, age range, circumstances — shown to you as “What I understood”.

rules.title: Deterministic matching rules
rules.body: The same fixed rules for everyone compare those facts with each program’s conditions.

database.title: Known program database
database.body: Programs collected from public sources, each with its source page.

explanation.title: Explanation + next steps
explanation.body: Strong potential match, Possible match or More information needed — with every reason shown.

how.llmTitle: The language model does not create programs or decide eligibility.
how.llmBody: Programs come only from the database. Whether one may fit comes only from the matching rules. If Gemini is used, it can only record facts and call those rules — it can’t add a program or change a label.
how.llmPrivate: Safety concerns are recognised by fixed rules too, before any model is involved. Private guided mode never sends your words to an AI service.

private.title: Private by design
private.body: No account, no stored conversations, nothing in the web address. Quick exit clears everything on this page.

honest.title: No false certainty
honest.body: No percentages and no “you qualify”. Each result says what fits and what still needs checking.

sources.title: Sources you can see
sources.body: Every program links to where its information came from, and says whether a person has reviewed it.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.body: If your words suggest danger, urgent help is shown before anything else.

cannot.decide: Decide whether you qualify — only the organization can.
cannot.submit: Submit applications for you — it helps you prepare, then points you to the official place to apply.
cannot.verify: Guarantee information is current — none of it has been reviewed by a person yet.
cannot.history: Erase your browser history — Quick exit replaces this page, but earlier history stays.
